\section{3. Targeting principle}




Alexander should not compete primarily as:




\begin{mdcode}
Bloque de codigo: text
Junior Unity Gameplay Programmer
\end{mdcode}




He should compete as:




\begin{mdcode}
Bloque de codigo: text

This means the search strategy should prioritize roles where TwinSight is not just “a project,” but direct evidence.

\section{8. Remote eligibility protocol}




Do not treat “remote” as enough.




Every posting must be labeled as one of:




\begin{mdcode}
Bloque de codigo: text
Worldwide
LATAM only
US only
Canada only
EU only
EU + NA
UK only
Hybrid
On-site
Unknown
\end{mdcode}




\subsection{8.1 Colombia suitability labels}




\begin{center}
\scriptsize
\begin{longtable}{>{\raggedright\arraybackslash}p{0.455\linewidth} >{\raggedright\arraybackslash}p{0.455\linewidth}}
\toprule
Label & Meaning \\
\midrule
\endfirsthead
\toprule
Label & Meaning \\
\midrule
\endhead
Colombia-eligible & explicitly LATAM/global/contractor \\
Likely eligible & no restriction visible, but remote/global wording \\
Unclear & remote but region not defined \\
Likely not eligible & EU/NA/US-only \\
Not eligible & work authorization excludes Colombia \\
\bottomrule
\end{longtable}
\end{center}




\subsection{8.2 Immediate filter}




Reject or postpone if:




\begin{mdcode}
Bloque de codigo: text
US work authorization required
EU work authorization required now
hybrid in city/country not accessible
security clearance required
onsite only
\end{mdcode}




Exception:




\begin{mdcode}
Bloque de codigo: text
Save for future EU/Portugal/Germany path if strategically relevant.
\end{mdcode}

\section{12. Search workflow}




\subsection{12.1 Daily search, 30–45 minutes}

\section{23. Interview-readiness implications}




\subsection{23.1 Prepare answers for}




\begin{mdcode}
Bloque de codigo: text
Why Unity WebGL?
How did you optimize CAD assets?
What was your exact role?
How much code did you write?
How did you use AI?
Is this a real digital twin?
How did you evaluate usability?
What would you improve next?
How would you adapt this to XR?
How would you work as a contractor from Colombia?
\end{mdcode}




\subsection{23.2 Highest-risk questions}




\begin{mdcode}
Bloque de codigo: text
Do you have professional Unity experience?
Have you shipped commercial games?
How deep is your shader experience?
Can you work independently without AI?
Can you handle production deadlines?
\end{mdcode}




\subsection{23.3 Defense strategy}




Do not pretend.




Use:




\begin{mdcode}
Bloque de codigo: text
I have limited formal industry experience, but my portfolio is built to demonstrate the relevant production-adjacent skills directly: Unity/C#, WebGL deployment, CAD optimization, runtime interaction, technical UI and structured evaluation.
\end{mdcode}

\section{24. Decision tree}




\subsection{24.1 Should Alexander apply?}




\begin{mdcode}
Bloque de codigo: text
Is it remote or Colombia/LATAM eligible?
    No → reject or future watchlist.
    Yes → continue.

Does it require senior shipped-title experience?
    Yes → only apply if fit ≥ 5 and portfolio match ≥ 4.
    No → continue.

Does TwinSight directly support the role?
    Yes → score high.
    No → continue.

Can CV + portfolio be tailored in under 30 minutes?
    Yes → apply if total ≥ 17.
    No → save unless priority A.

Does the role strengthen the target path?
    Yes → apply.
    No → reject.
\end{mdcode}




\subsection{24.2 Fast reject test}




Reject if three or more are true:




\begin{mdcode}
Bloque de codigo: text
senior only
mobile-only
onsite/hybrid outside Colombia
requires shipped commercial titles
requires Unreal only
requires advanced GPU programming
no portfolio relevance
unclear company/product
low/no pay
\end{mdcode}
